definitions.explanation: An official public record maintained by a government office, containing registered information about real estate, companies, or other legally significant matters.

examples.japanese: {登記簿|とうきぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登記簿|とうきぼ}⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I obtained a certified copy of the real estate registry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{登記簿|とうきぼ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{所有者|しょゆうしゃ}→所有者：21212_shoyuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: When purchasing land, it's important to verify the owner in the registry.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧ (registration; recording) + {簿|ぼ} (ledger; book). An essential term in Japanese real estate and corporate law. Anyone buying property or investigating a company in Japan will encounter this term. The {登記簿|とうきぼ}⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧ (certified copy of the registry) is a key document in real estate transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登記簿|とうきぼ}⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧: certified copy of the registry
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧{登記簿|とうきぼ}: real estate registry
- ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧{登記簿|とうきぼ}: commercial registry
- {登記簿|とうきぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閲覧|えつらん}する→閲覧する：18280_etsuransuru⟧: to inspect the registry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧: family register — records family relationships and personal status; different from property/corporate registration
- ⟦{台帳|だいちょう}→台帳：08001_daichou⟧: ledger; register — a more general term for any official record book
